about: Curated national-guideline first doses the census compares against: AHA/ILCOR algorithms, the NASEMSO National Model EMS Clinical Guidelines, and single-topic society guidance. Each entry quotes its source verbatim; dose (to max, when the guideline gives a range) is in the group unit. Several entries may share a key (two bodies, or one body naming two doses). Hand-maintained: edit only against the primary source.

entries.title: Tranexamic Acid in Trauma: joint position statement of NAEMSP, ACEP and ACS-COT (2025)
entries.quote: Current evidence suggests EMS agencies may administer either a 1-g intravenous/intraosseous dose (followed by a hospital-based 1-g infusion over 8 hours) or a 2-g intravenous/intraosseous dose as an infusion or slow push.
